units.source_text: 藤壶皇后是今上的母亲，但因已经出家，不能升任皇太后。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo was the mother of the reigning emperor, but because she had already taken religious vows, she could not be elevated to empress dowager.

units.source_text: 于是依照上皇的标准赐与封赠，又任命专职侍卫，宫中规模之盛大，非昔日可比了。

en.t: Therefore she was granted titles and honors on the level accorded to a retired emperor, and dedicated guards were appointed for her; the magnificence of her household could no longer be compared with former days.

units.source_text: 皇后每日诵经礼佛，勤修法事。

en.t: The empress recited sutras and worshiped the Buddha every day, diligently carrying out religious rites.

units.source_text: 长时期来为忌惮弘徽殿太后，不便出入宫禁，不能常常看到冷泉帝，引以为恨。

en.t: For a long time, out of fear of the Kokiden Empress Dowager, she had found it difficult to enter and leave the palace and had been unable to see Emperor Reizei often, which she deeply regretted.

units.source_text: 现在她可以随意进出，无所顾虑，甚是快意。

en.t: Now she could come and go as she pleased, with nothing to worry about, and this gave her great satisfaction.

units.source_text: 反之，弘徽殿太后却在悲叹时运不济了。

en.t: By contrast, the Kokiden Empress Dowager was lamenting her own ill fortune.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣每有机会，必关怀弘徽殿太后，对她表示敬意。

en.t: Whenever the opportunity arose, Genji, the inner minister, was sure to show concern for the Kokiden Empress Dowager and offer her his respect.

units.source_text: 世人不平，都认为这太后不该受这善报。

en.t: People felt indignant, and all believed that this empress dowager did not deserve such good fortune.
